description: Fetch a site's homepage and up to max_pages-1 contact/about pages and return every email, phone (validated, E.164, type), WhatsApp link, social profile, postal address and organisation field found, with provenance per item. Example: url 'noahsarch.tech', max_pages 3, region 'AE'. Response: result with emails[] (email, source, role), phones[] (e164, international, region, type, source), whatsapp[], social{platform: [url, handle]}, addresses[], organization{}, pages[] (what was fetched, status) and summary{}, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Charged per page actually fetched; failed fetches are free. URLs are not logged.

follow_contact_pages.description: Also fetch the site's contact/about/impressum pages (same site only).
follow_contact_pages.title: Follow Contact Pages

include_social.description: Include social-profile links (Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, Snapchat, Pinterest, Threads, GitHub…).
include_social.title: Include Social

max_pages.description: Homepage plus up to (max_pages-1) contact/about pages found on it. 1 = homepage only.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used to interpret phone numbers written without a country code (e.g. 'AE', 'GB', 'US'). Omit if unknown.
region.title: Region

respect_robots.description: Honour the site's robots.txt (default). Set false only for sites you own.
respect_robots.title: Respect Robots

name: extract_contacts
title: Extract contacts from a website
